title: Only a worker's config hides libraries, and a config with none hides nothing
description: Since JS-076 every role runs library.Sync at start, and Sync hides every library its config leaves out. Only the worker uses the synced libraries, yet an api or stream replica, or a worker, started with a different or empty libraries list hides every other library from every viewer until a replica with the full config starts again, and removes it after missingGrace. Seen as a flake in JS-031's parallel tests.
acceptanceCriteria: A process without the worker role (`api`, `stream` or `api,stream`) writes nothing to the libraries at start, whatever its config lists: it adds no library, renames none, changes no store or `chapterImages`, hides none and shows none again.

That holds for each list such a replica may have: no config file, no `libraries` key, an empty list, a subset of the worker's list, an entry under another name for a store the worker lists, and an entry the database lacks.

Shown with real processes on one database: with a worker listing two or more libraries, an api replica and a stream replica with differing lists (one empty, one a subset), started after the worker and at the same instant as one another, leave every library in /UserViews and every item in its listings, asked of that api replica, with no worker restart.
They stay so after missingGrace has passed and a worker scan tick has run with those replicas still up: no library, item or user_item_data row is removed, and no library's grace has started.

A process with the worker role, alone or beside others (`worker`, `api,worker`, `all`), still syncs a non-empty list as before: it adds a new library, keeps a renamed one's id, hides one the list leaves out, shows again one put back, and its tick removes a hidden one once missingGrace has passed since the first worker start without it.

A worker (alone or in `all`) whose config lists no libraries, whether by no config file, no `libraries` key or an empty list, changes no library: with two or more in the database, all stay in /UserViews with their items and watch state after missingGrace has passed and a tick has run, and one that a worker's earlier config hid stays hidden with the grace it had.
That worker logs, once per start and not on every scan tick, that its config lists no libraries and that the libraries in the database were kept; a process without the worker role logs no such line.

docs/running.md says that every worker must list the same libraries, and what happens otherwise: a worker whose list leaves a library out hides it from every viewer and starts its grace, whatever the other workers list.

docs/running.md says that the `libraries` of api and stream replicas are not read, that a worker listing none hides and removes nothing (so emptying the list does not remove the last library), and that a library's grace runs from the first worker start without it, no longer from any start.
source: Escape from JS-076, found in JS-031's build (2026-11-13)
